βίαντος: Βίας — Bias, father of Laogonus and Dardanus; masc. gen. sg.
βαθέ: βαθύς — deep, thick; neut. acc. pl., elided (βαθέ’ = βαθέα): ’deep’
βαθεῖα: βαθύς — deep, dense; fem. nom. sg.: ’deep’
βαρυνθεὶς: βαρύνω — weigh down, make heavy; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg., with an acc. of respect: ’weighed down (in his hand)’
γαίη: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg., epic γαίῃ (= Attic γῇ), after ποτί: ’to the ground’
γλυκύθυμος: γλυκύθυμος — sweet-hearted, soft-natured; adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg.
δημοῦχον: Δημοῦχος — Demuchus, son of Philetor; masc. acc. sg.
δρύοπ: Δρύοψ — Dryops; masc. acc. sg., elided (Δρύοπ’ = Δρύοπα)
εἰλυφάζει: εἰλυφάζω — swirl, roll about (rare; sense from context, of wind and fire); pres. 3 sg. act.: ’swirls’
εὐρυμετώπους: εὐρυμέτωπος — broad-browed; adj. (2 endings), masc./fem. acc. pl., agreeing with βόας (cattle)
ζεύξῃ: ζεύγνυμι — yoke, harness; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general clause with ὅτε: ’yokes’
θείνας: θείνω — strike, smite; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’having struck’
κάρ: κατά — down; prep./preverb, apocope κάρ before ῥ- (= κατά), in tmesis with the verb: ’down (over)’
κατακτείνειεν: κατακτείνω — kill; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., in a hoped-for outcome after εἴ πως … μηδέ: ’might kill’
κὰγ: κατά — down; prep., apocope κὰγ before γ- (= κατά), + acc. of the part struck: ’in the knee’
λέπτ: λεπτός — fine, thin, delicate; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (λέπτ’ = λεπτά); as predicate: ’fine’
λίσσεσθ: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. inf. mid./dep., elided (λίσσεσθ’ = λίσσεσθαι): ’to beseech’
λιαζόμενον: λιάζομαι — bend, sink down, sag; pres. part. mid./dep. masc. acc. sg.: ’sinking down’
νηδύϊ: νηδύς — belly, stomach; fem. dat. sg., place where: ’in the belly’
ξυνέχουσι: συνέχω — hold together, join; pres. 3 pl. act., epic ξυν- (= Attic συν-): ’hold together’
οὐτάζων: οὐτάζω — wound, thrust at; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’thrusting at’
πείρεω: Πείρως — Peirous, father of Rhigmus; masc. gen. sg., epic Πείρεω (= Attic Πείρω)
πεφίδοιτο: φείδομαι — spare (+ gen.); 2nd aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., epic reduplicated, after εἴ πως: ’might spare’
πτώσσοιμεν: πτώσσω — cower, crouch in fear; pres. opt. 1 pl. act., potential with ἄν: ’we would cower’
πόσσ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic πόσσι, elided (πόσσ’ = ποσσί; Attic ποσί): ’under the feet’
στρέψαντα: στρέφω — turn, wheel round; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having turned’
στρωφᾶσθ: στρωφάω — turn about, move to and fro; pres. inf. mid., elided (στρωφᾶσθ’ = στρωφᾶσθαι), after ἔτλη: ’to keep turning about’
σφονδυλίων: σφονδύλιον (σφόνδυλος) — vertebra; masc./neut. gen. pl., of separation after ἐκ- in ἔκπαλτο: ’from the vertebrae’
τένοντες: τένων — sinew, tendon; masc. nom. pl.
τανυσθείς: τανύω — stretch out; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’stretched out’
τριβέμεναι: τρίβω — rub, thresh (grain); pres. inf. act., epic -μεναι (= Attic τρίβειν): ’to rub out, thresh’
φιλητορίδην: Φιλητορίδης — son of Philetor, patronymic; masc. acc. sg.
χείρεσι: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσι (= Attic χερσί)
χειρότερός: χειρότερος — worse, inferior (comparative of κακός); masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic περ: ’worse’
ψύξασα: ψύχω — breathe, blow; also cool; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having breathed’
ἀγήνορος: Ἀγήνωρ — Agenor, father of Echeclus; masc. gen. sg.
ἀγανόφρων: ἀγανόφρων — gentle-minded, kindly; adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg.
ἀζαλέοιο: ἀζαλέος — dry, parched; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀλαστορίδην: Ἀλαστορίδης — son of Alastor, patronymic (of Tros); masc. acc. sg.
ἀναμαιμάει: ἀναμαιμάω — rage through, sweep through (rare; sense from context, of fire); pres. 3 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic -μαιμᾷ)
ἀνεπᾶλτο: ἀναπάλλομαι — leap up, spring up; aor. 3 sg. mid., syncopated (ἀν-έπαλ-το): ’leapt up’
ἀρηΐθοον: Ἀρηΐθοος — Areithous, attendant of Rhigmus; masc. acc. sg.
ἄρσενας: ἄρσην (Attic ἄρρην) — male; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with βόας (cattle): ’male’
ἐνέπλησεν: ἐμπίμπλημι — fill (+ acc.); aor. 3 sg. act., ἐν- before π (ἐνέπλησε), ν-movable: ’filled’
ἐξήρπαξεν: ἐξαρπάζω — snatch away, carry off; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’snatched away’
ἐριμύκων: ἐρίμυκος — loud-bellowing (ἐρι- intensive + μυκάομαι ’bellow’); adj. (2 endings), masc. gen. pl., agreeing with βοῶν
ἐφέπων: ἐφέπω — pursue, go after; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’pursuing’
ἔκπαλθ: ἐκπάλλω — shake out; mid. leap out, spring out; aor. 3 sg. mid., syncopated, elided and aspirated (ἔκπαλθ’ = ἔκπαλτο): ’sprang out’
ὄλισθεν: ὀλισθάνω — slip, slide; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ὤλισθε): ’slipped out’
ῥίγμον: Ῥίγμος — Rhigmus, a Thracian, son of Peirous; masc. acc. sg.
στεῖβον: στείβω — tread, trample; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔστειβον)
τετιμένον: τιμάω — honour; perf. part. pass. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic τετιμημένον): ’honoured’
τύψας: τύπτω — strike, beat; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck’
ἀλωῇ: ἀλωή — plot, orchard, vineyard; threshing-floor (= ἅλως); fem. dat. sg.
ἄγκεα: ἄγκος — glen, valley, mountain-hollow; neut. acc. pl.
ἐλεήσας: ἐλεέω — pity, take pity on; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having pitied’
ἐφορμηθεὶς: ἐφορμάομαι — rush at, dart upon; aor. part. pass. (mid. force) masc. nom. sg.: ’having rushed upon’
ἔπειρεν: πείρω — pierce, run through, spit; impf. 3 sg. (augmented ἔ-πειρε), ν-movable

__broaden__.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a dative: ’to her herself’ (αὐτῇ περ νοεούσῃ ’even though she herself understands’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after ἅμα: ’with her’ · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after ἐν, of a thing: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ ’in it’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after παρά: ’beside her’ · also fem. dat. sg. as a plain pronoun after σύν: ’with her’ · also intensive, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a thing (πήληκι): ’the helmet itself’
__broaden__.αὐχένα: αὐχήν — neck; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐξ … ἄξῃ (tmesis): ’breaks the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of βάλλω: ’hit the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of τύπτε: ’struck the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of ἔλασσεν: ’struck the neck’ (αὐχένα μέσσον ἔλασσεν ’struck the neck in the middle’) · also masc. acc. sg., of the place struck after κατά: ’in the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of θείνας: ’having struck the neck’
__broaden__.γόνυ: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. sg., object of κάμψειν: γόνυ κάμψειν ’to bend the knee’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἀμείβων: ’(changing) knee’ (γόνυ γουνὸς ἀμείβων ’changing knee after knee’) · also neut. acc. sg., of the place struck after κατά (κὰγ): ’in the knee’
__broaden__.γούνων: γόνυ — knee; neut. gen. pl., epic γούνων (= Attic γονάτων); gen. of the part grasped, after λαβέ · also neut. gen. pl., with λίσσομαι ’beseech’: ’at the knees’ · also neut. gen. pl., gen. of the part touched, after ἅπτομαι: ’took hold of the knees’ · also neut. gen. pl., depending on ἀντίος: ’facing the knees’
__broaden__.καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, down to; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing (καθ’ ἕδρας ’down to their seats’) · also + acc., ’through, throughout’ (καθ’ ὕλην ’through the wood’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (καθ’ ἵππων) · also + acc., ’according to’ (καθ’ ἡμέτερον νόον ’according to our mind’) · also + acc., ’at, among’, of what one is busy with (καθ’ ἵππους ’among his horses’) · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in’ (καθ’ ἧπαρ ’in the liver’)
__broaden__.κεφαλὴν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of a verb of lifting: ’head’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of κόψεν: ’head’ (κεφαλὴν … ἀπὸ δειρῆς κόψεν ’cut the head from the neck’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of πῆξαι and of ταμόντα: ’head’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἐνεῖκαι ’bring’: ’head’ · also fem. acc. sg., after κὰκ of the place struck: ’on the head’
__broaden__.μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj. with an imperative (prohibition) · also ’and not’ with an infinitive after a verb of bidding (παύεσθαι κέλομαι, μηδὲ … πολεμίζειν) · also ’and do not’ with an infinitive used as a command (μηδὲ … καλλείπειν ’and do not leave’) · also ’and not’ continuing a ὅπως clause with opt. (ὅπως … διέλθοιεν μηδὲ τρομεοίατο ’that they pass and not tremble’) · also ’and not’ + opt., continuing an εἰ-clause of hoped-for outcome (μηδὲ κατακτείνειεν ’and not kill’)
__broaden__.πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς before a following enclitic (οἱ): ’lest somehow’ · also accented before the enclitic με, softening a statement: ’somehow, rather’ (μάλα πώς με ’very much, somehow, me’) · also accented before the enclitic εὑ, after εἴ: ’if somehow’
__broaden__.χείρων: Χείρων — Chiron, the wise centaur, healer and teacher; masc. nom. sg. · also χείρων — worse, inferior (comparative of κακός); masc./fem. nom. sg.: ’worse’
__broaden__.ἕλωμαι: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with κεν: ’I shall take’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., after μή of fear: ’lest I take’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., in a condition with αἴ κε: ’if I take’
